scope: Post hoc read-only diagnosis of validation_near_high_1; not an additional simulation
interpretation: The dominant edge difference exactly matches the size of one two-window raw packet. This is consistent with one extra such packet transmission, but no tile-level transfer log was captured, so the task ID and decision trigger are not established.
counter_limitation: raw_relay_hops counts raw_relay_path. In the distributed pipeline ordinary OFFLOAD does not initialize this path; the automatic raw-ground-relay path does. Zero raw_relay_hops is therefore not evidence of zero ordinary raw offloading.
metric_boundary: Identical age scores and task completion sets do not imply stable routing actions or ISL traffic. The 6.288838 MB traffic difference is not floating-point accumulation error.
